title: Blocked a shot with a grey 3D model, then let Seedance 2.5 render it
author: Practical_Low29
selftext:
Saw a thread telling people to stop burning tokens on basic 3D animation: grab a Tripo model, rig it, animate it. I wanted the next step, where the grey model is only a camera and blocking pass and a video model does the look.

1. Tripo H3.1 text-to-3D for a chubby toy dinosaur. 0.22, a bit over 2 minutes.
2. A grey previs in three.js: the dino hops three times while the camera orbits 100 degrees and pushes in. 6 seconds, rendered locally.
3. Seedance 2.5 reference-to-video with the previs as @Video1, told to follow the camera path, framing, timing and the three hops exactly, but render a glossy mint green vinyl toy on a sunny toy shop shelf.

The orbit, the push in and all three hops line up with the previs, and nothing grey leaks into the shot. It also kept the ending where the dino turns to face the lens, and added the pink spikes and yellow belly from the prompt.

Seedance was 2.16 and took about 5 minutes. Everything ran through the Atlas Cloud MCP server from one Claude Code session. Prompt in the comments.

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body:
There is no need to use paid services for something this basic.

Both LTX and Minimax can do this easily.
